packet.title: tree-sitter functions in a tree-sitter namespace (design and implementation)

body.p: After , , and . The owner (2026-10-22): expose tree-sitter as tree-sitter:, not as sxml:code-*. Today sxml:parse-code and sxml:code-languages live in urn:sxml ().

item.p: Design: a well-known namespace for the tree-sitter functions, bound to the prefix tree-sitter as bin and file are (name.h, additive after , as and added theirs); the functions' names in it (proposed: tree-sitter:parse and tree-sitter:languages, same signatures and options); where the unknown-language error goes. sxml:parse-code and sxml:code-languages are removed, not kept as aliases. Recorded as a decision that amends 's API paragraph; the glossary updated.

Owns: 7.22's, 7.23's and 7.25's files, the namespace part of include/sxml/name.h and the comments of include/sxml that name the functions, the prefix bindings of apps/sxml, bindings/host and bindings/javascript, every test and book page that calls the functions (source-code.md, ixml-performance.md, the codegen chapter's check.xq, the examples under docs/book/examples).

Done when: the CLI, XQuery prologs and stylesheets reach the functions through the tree-sitter prefix; tree-sitter/suite unchanged (1,410 of 1,438); the book's examples match; no sxml:parse-code or sxml:code-languages left in code, tests or docs (decision records excepted).

body.p: Done 2026-10-22 (): tree-sitter:parse and tree-sitter:languages in urn:sxml:tree-sitter (name.h SXML_NAMESPACE_TREE_SITTER = 17), errors tree-sitter:unknown-language and tree-sitter:invalid-query; the sxml command and the JavaScript package bind tree-sitter; tree-sitter/suite 1,410 of 1,438, unchanged; the book's affected examples match. The old names remain only in records (DECISIONS, LOG, QUEUE's history, the 0.2.0 CHANGELOG section, the 7.22 and 7.26 entries here).
